items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Mitchell Parrish was a lyrics writer, and he wrote the lyrics to "Minnie the Moocher."

ctx.x: Mitchell Parrish was a lyrics writer, and he wrote the lyrics to "Minnie the Moocher." So we got... I wish I could think of the guy's name that he got to make this arrangement. This guy is now a big-time arranger in New York. He used to arrange for the Mills Brothers... Because Mills had the Mills Brothers... And he got him to make this arrangement.
